\newcount\CFformatted
\newcount\CFmiddlecalls
\newwrite\CFwritten
\immediate\openout\CFwritten=\jobname.nodes
\let\CFformat\DirtreexFormatName
\renewcommand\DirtreexFormatName[1]{%
  \global\advance\CFformatted by1
  \write\CFwritten{ENTRY #1}%
  \CFformat{#1}}
\makeatletter
\let\CFmiddle\dte@compute@availht@middle
\def\dte@compute@availht@middle{%
  \global\advance\CFmiddlecalls by1
  \ifnum\CFmiddlecalls>100 \errmessage{Continuation failed to make progress}\fi
  \typeout{CF-MIDDLE-BEFORE page=\thepage;goal=\the\pagegoal;total=\the\pagetotal;vsize=\the\vsize;colroom=\the\@colroom}%
  \CFmiddle
  \typeout{CF-MIDDLE-AFTER target=\the\dte@availht}}
\let\CFpiece\dte@drawpiece
\def\dte@drawpiece#1{%
  \typeout{CF-PIECE #1;page=\thepage;ht=\the\ht\dte@splitresult;dp=\the\dp\dte@splitresult}%
  \CFpiece{#1}}
\AtEndDocument{\typeout{CF-PIECENUM \the\dte@piecenum}}
\makeatother
\AddToHook{shipout/before}{\ifnum\value{page}>30 \errmessage{Too many pages}\fi}
\AtEndDocument{\typeout{CF-FORMATTED \the\CFformatted}}


\newcount\ATleaders
\newcommand\ATleader{\global\advance\ATleaders by1\relax\color{green!50!black}\hrulefill}
\newcommand\ATsave{\edef\ATsaved{\the\parfillskip|\the\parskip|\the\parindent|\the\baselineskip|\the\lineskip|\the\lineskiplimit|\the\topskip}}
\newcommand\ATcheck{\edef\ATnow{\the\parfillskip|\the\parskip|\the\parindent|\the\baselineskip|\the\lineskip|\the\lineskiplimit|\the\topskip}\ifx\ATnow\ATsaved\else\errmessage{A2 glue scoping mismatch}\fi\typeout{A2-RESTORE \ATnow}\typeout{A2-LEADERS \the\ATleaders}}
\makeatletter
\renewcommand\DirtreexFormatName[1]{\global\advance\CFformatted by1\write\CFwritten{ENTRY #1}\typeout{A2-NAME #1|\the\parfillskip|\the\parskip}\sffamily\color{magenta}\CFformat{#1}}
\makeatother
